topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can hardly believe my eyes, staring at the screen, my words, my thoughts, displayed for all to see. They took it, my application essay, the one I poured every ounce of myself into, and now it's an "example." What a cruel twist of fate. I never consented to this, never imagined my private struggles and aspirations would be public fodder. The lines blur between exposure and exploitation, and I'm left here, grappling with the shadows cast by this revelation. How do I move forward, knowing my innermost self has been laid bare without my say?
